status: Approved dataset for the Week 4 Tableau challenge
source: PokéAPI community-maintained database (not an official Nintendo dataset)
scope: One default form per species. Alternate, Mega and regional forms excluded. Names use language 9 (English) and language 1 (Japanese). Types are the default form's types at the source snapshot, not necessarily the types at original release.

fields.Pokedex_ID: Species identifier / National Pokédex number; treat as an identifier, not an additive measure
fields.Name: English species name
fields.Generation: Generation when the species was introduced; categorical, not a year or a historical stats version
fields.Type_2: Secondary type, English; blank means no second type
fields.Type_2_Japanese: Secondary type, Japanese; blank means no second type
fields.Height_m: Default-form height in metres; source decimetres divided by 10
fields.Weight_kg: Default-form weight in kilograms; source hectograms divided by 10
fields.HP: Base HP stat, not an individual Pokémon's level-dependent HP
fields.Base_Stat_Total: Sum of the six base stats; not a universal measure of battle performance
fields.Mythical: Source species classification, Yes/No; separate from Legendary

tableau_notes: Use Name or Pokedex_ID on Detail to obtain one mark per species.
Use Generation as a discrete dimension, not SUM(Generation).
For comparisons by type or generation, distinguish average stats from counts. Primary-type comparisons ignore the secondary type unless you explicitly include it.
For a smaller first exercise, filter Generation to 1. Do not infer real animal biology from fictional game attributes.
